notes.title: Treasures of the Aegean joins the Winter Sale!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40418364/33bcfd207f5fee80539cc9a94cebc2408457db85.png[/img]

Hello Treasure Hunters!

We're happy to announce that Treasures of the Aegean is available at a discount price for the first time, as part of Steam's Winter Sale! So, if you still don't have the game, please take this opportunity to become a treasure hunter!

As you've seen in the Community Hub, we've been working on game fixes and polish after the initial launch and giving player support, so everyone can find all the clues to uncover the true fate of the Minoan Civilization.

We'd also like to share that we're really pleased with the game's reception and we value a lot all of your feedback and comments. For a small team like us, it's really great to see players enjoying the game we've put so much effort in creating. 

We hope you all are safe and have a great holiday season!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607530/Treasures_of_the_Aegean/

notes.title: ✨Treasures of the Aegean✨ is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40418364/47bc4dac222572db8b6d912029a28a2c6a99f662.png[/img]

Hello Treasure Hunters!

We're happy to announce that Treasures of the Aegean is now available to download! It's been a long 3 year journey for our team and we're really excited to fianlly be able to share our creation with everyone.

As previously announced, the game has been designed in 4K from ground up so we hope you enjoy the hand-drawn graphics. Several graphic options have been added in terms of texture quality too, in order to run smoothly in every computer. 

Controller support has been added and the game will natively recognize Xbox, PS and switch gamepads (showing the corresponding icons) as well as generic ones. Rumble and achievements are supported too!

Besides the main game, we've also uploaded some of the materials that will be included with the consoles collector physical esitions, such as soundtrack and comic, so that everyone can enjoy them if they want to.

Finally, we prepared a new trailer for launch:

[previewyoutube=cfJYPjEBOXE;full][/previewyoutube]

What do you think of it?

On behalf of all the team behind Treasures of the Aegean we sincerely hope you enjoy the game!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607530/Treasures_of_the_Aegean/

notes.title: Making of Treasures of the Aegean
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40418364/a57dea2c983c7a26dcacf1411e12d12b11582004.jpg[/img]

We're just [b]one day away from the release of Treasures of the Aegean[/b]!

notes.title: 🎦 Developer Commented Demo Gameplay now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40418364/706338d8d258a0e8cb445b91d00d6b7167f26bf2.png[/img]

Hello Treasure Hunters!

Today we're bringing you a recording of the [b]Developer Commented live stream[/b], which we aired during the Steam NEXT Festival a few weeks ago, just in case you missed it back then. 

In the video one of our team members plays through the demo version of Treasures of the Aegean, while commenting about how the game works, its design and systems, the characters and back story and a few other developer insights. 

Please note that the demo version[b] has a few differences[/b] compared to the final game (especially when it comes to treasure and artifact location) and it [b]only includes a small portion of the island[/b], so please don't take it as a "guide" for the first minutes. These level changes were made so that the demo was conclusive.

The video is recorded in Full HD, but the game supports native 4K.

We hope you enjoy it!

[previewyoutube=6Igs5pPwvis;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🗓️ Release date & collector's edition announced!
notes.notes:
Good news, treasure hunters!

After a great Steam Next Fest, we're happy to announce that we finally have an [b]official release date for Treasures of the Aegean[/b]... and it's very, very soon:

[h2]November 11th, 2021[/h2]

That's less than a month left to go! Everyone in the team is excited to share this game with everyone, as it's the work of almost three years of development.

For PC & Console users, we also want to share some big news: Treasures of the Aegean will have a [b]physical Collector's edition[/b], thanks to our publisher Numskull Games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40418364/64d98edf31f862ba348bddb300905ef86da6510a.jpg[/img]

This edition includes an original comic + artbook, with the prologue of the game and some artwork too, a CD soundtrack and a cloth map of the island. It will be available for PS4, PS5 and Switch.

Of course, we're planning to offer the comic/artbook and soundtrack also as a [b]digital download[/b] here on Steam for PC users!

Please wishlist and [url=https://twitter.com/undercoders/]follow us[/url], so you don't miss any important announcement :)

Best,

[b]Undercoders' Team
[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607530/Treasures_of_the_Aegean/

notes.title: ✨Steam Festival Demo OUT NOW✨
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40418364/e674504fa898aac6c66455fd937912a1612d2678.png[/img]
Good news everyone,

We're happy to announce that the Steam NEXT Festival Demo of Treasures of the Aegean is [b]out now[/b]!  We hope you enjoy playing it and look forward to receiving your feedback :) 

We'll also be streaming both[b] developer commented and non-commented gameplay[/b] during the duration of the festival. You can check the stream directly from the Steam Store Page.

Here's a quick F.A.Q. for the demo, but don't hesitate to ask us if you have further questions about it.

[i][b]
What can you expect from this demo and what does it include?[/b][/i]

The demo includes the first two loops of the game. This means that it has all the introductory scenes, background story, tutorial and all the player actions available. 
[i][b]
Can the game be saved? [/b][/i]

Yes, the progress can also be saved but the second loop won't be saved so you can replay it any number of times you want.

[i][b]Is the save data compatible with the full game?[/b][/i]

No. We had to drop this, since the demo has certain elements in the island which have been modified from the final game. We had to make these changes in order for the demo to be a conclusive experience.

[i][b]How big is the demo?
[/b][/i]
In the demo you'll be able to explore a small part of the island with all of its features and complete part of the adventure.

[i][b]How can I contact the developers?[/b][/i]

The best way to reach us is through the Community Hub or through our Twitter account.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1607530/Treasures_of_the_Aegean/

notes.title: NEXT Festival demo incoming!
notes.notes:

We're happy to announce that Treasures of the Aegean will be participating in the NEXT Steam Festival, with its[b] very first playable demo[/b]!
